preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.
The number of cities is between 2 and 3000.
The cities are numbered from 1 to n, and the roads connect a pair of different cities.

preconditions.expression: The sum of all values of n for all test cases in the input does not exceed 3000.
preconditions.description: The total number of cities across all test cases does not exceed 3000.

postconditions.description: The minimum possible number of roads assigned to the most used company is between 1 and 10^6.
Each company number is between 1 and 10^6.

postconditions.expression: For each city, there should be no more than two different companies that repair roads related to this city.
postconditions.description: The distribution of roads ensures that each city is connected by at most two different companies.

postconditions.expression: r is the maximum number of roads assigned to any company.
postconditions.description: The value of r is the minimum possible number of roads assigned to the most used company.
